<!--
  Pull Request template: Documentation Update
  Mirrors the Documentation Issue issue template (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/documentation_issue.yml).
-->

## Related Issue
<!-- Link the documentation issue this PR fixes: #123, or "None" if none exists -->

## Issue Type
<!-- Keep the applicable option(s) from the Documentation Issue template -->
- [ ] Missing Information
- [ ] Incorrect/Outdated Info
- [ ] Poor Clarity / Hard to Understand
- [ ] Broken Link
- [ ] Translation Issue (RU/EN)
- [ ] Suggestion for Improvement

## Location
<!-- File name (with line numbers if relevant) or section title in README/Doxygen docs -->

## Description
<!-- What was wrong or missing in the documentation. -->

## Change Details
<!-- What was changed: updated text, new section, fixed links, corrected Doxygen comments, etc. -->
<!-- If the change affects build/install instructions, note which parts (Linux, Windows). -->

## Docs Built / Rendered Correctly
<!-- If Doxygen or other generated docs are affected: confirm they build without new warnings. -->

## Author Checklist
- [ ] Related documentation issue linked (if one exists).
- [ ] No code changes included (if code changes are needed, they belong in a separate PR).
- [ ] Spelling and grammar checked (in the language of the document).
- [ ] Links verified (no broken links introduced).
- [ ] Translation-consistent: RU and EN versions kept in sync (if the project has both).
